Gaming Laptop Deals

(Image credit: Tom's Hardware)

It's time for Black Friday deals, so if you're in the market for a cheap gaming laptop, you're in the right place. We're constantly combing through the best deals across multiple retailers, such as Best Buy, Newegg, Walmart, and Amazon, backing up our deal selections with in-depth reviews, benchmarks, and comprehensive historical pricing analysis. We're checking deals around the clock to find the best options and keep this page up to date, but please note that they often won't last long, so you'll need to act quickly.

There may also be some older laptops, which you should definitely avoid. For instance, anything older than one generation is better off avoided. If you have the cash, spring for a system with a GPU with at least 8GB of VRAM, 16GB of RAM, and at least 512GB of storage.

We also maintain lists of the best gaming laptops, the best gaming laptops under $1,500, and the best gaming laptops under $1,000, should you want to peruse some of our favorites.
